rules: FOUND requires a source-backed site-specific claim or observation.
PUBLIC_LEAD_REVIEW_REQUIRED is discovery only and cannot overwrite a canonical field.
NO_PUBLIC_RECORD must state the search scope and source families checked.
Do not infer values from geographic proximity, company-wide disclosures, queue MW, utility service capacity, or generic equipment announcements.
Preserve conflicts; do not select a winner without source-based reconciliation.
